notes.notes:
Fixed a bug where the pointer effect did not appear on the red side in Private Battle

notes.title: Release Commemoration Review Share Campaign!
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "Jelly Troops."



To celebrate launch, we're holding a special launch campaign.

We hope you'll join us!


Launch Battle Party ~Every Night at 9 PM is Battle Time!~
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45097677/adb76ef4cc6b32452e64df30d364d1efdf6b1d53.png"]



Thursday, Sept. 18, 2025 - Sunday, Sept. 28, 2025



1. Every Night at 9 PM is Battle Time!

 During the Campaign, the Launch Battle Party kicks off every night at 9 PM!

 The dev team sill join in too!



2. Review Campaign

 Randomly select 10 winners from those who post & share reviews or gameplay screenshots

 to receive a 500 JPY Steam Gift Card!





1. Play Jelly Troops on Steam or Switch

2. Review or take a screenshot (video) of the gameplay screen.

3. Post on X or Instagram with the hashtag #JellyTroops and a screenshot (or video).
